title: services/auth tsconfig EXCLUDES src/__tests__ — every 'tsc: 0 errors' on a test-only change in this service is a green that could not fail
description:
## BLUF

`services/auth/tsconfig.json` **excludes** `src/__tests__`**, so** `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` **type-checks NONE of that service's test files.** Every *"*`tsc`*: 0* `error TS`*"* reported on a test-only change in this service is a **green that could not have failed**.

## Measured

```
services/auth/tsconfig.json
  include: ["src/**/*"]
  exclude: ["node_modules", "dist", "src/__tests__"]
```

The gate demonstrated the consequence rather than arguing it: **a planted type error in the test file produced 0 errors, while the identical plant in** `userRepo.ts` **produced** `TS2322`**.** Same command, same invocation — one file is checked and the other is not, and nothing in the output says which.

## Why this is filed separately from the #907 residue

Different logical path, and **wider than one PR**: this is a repo-wide instrument gap, not a defect in the change that exposed it.

## 🔴 It has already produced a false evidence line, and it was mine

[#907](<https://github.com/Secuura/Distributed_Secuura/pull/907>)'s Test Evidence block cited *"*`tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` *— 0* `error TS` *lines"* for a change that added **~110 lines of test code**. That line is true of `userRepo.ts` and says **nothing whatsoever** about the suite. I reported it as evidence covering both. The PR body now carries the correction.

**That is the point of the ticket:** the number was real, the command was real, and the conclusion was unearned — and there is no way to tell from the output. Any seat would have reported it the same way.

## Items

- [ ] **1. Decide the shape.** Either include `src/__tests__` in the type-check (a second `tsconfig.test.json` is the usual answer, since test files legitimately need looser settings), or state in writing that tests are deliberately unchecked and stop citing `tsc` as evidence for them.
- [ ] **2. Whichever is chosen, make the output honest** — a checker that silently examines a subset must say which subset. *"0 errors"* over an empty file set is the exact shape of [KS-676](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-676) (the CVE scan that reported clean having examined nothing).
- [ ] **3. Sweep the sibling services.** `auth` is where it was found; whether the other 20+ services exclude their tests the same way is **not measured** — do not assume either answer.
- [ ] **4. Add the planted-error check as a cell**, so the instrument's own coverage is pinned and this cannot silently re-open.

## Provenance

Tier-1 QA gate on #907, finding F5, relayed in Wednesday's GO of 04:41:56Z (**DKIM-verified as her relay**) and **independently re-verified here by reading** `tsconfig.json` before filing.

nodes.body:
State corrected: In Review to In Progress. Items 1, 2 and 4 are delivered for services/auth; item 3, the sibling sweep, is not finished.

Done, all on develop and ancestors of the kintsugi deploy b1fb543640e7: PR 1480 (8cfab55b0) type-checks the auth test files against a baseline that can only shrink. PR 1499 (6b978ca38) runs the ratchet at push time (preflight leg 16). PR 1506 (f6f2a539f) makes it refuse a swap, `@ts-nocheck` and a narrowed tsconfig. KS-1351 item 3 (559947aa2) added vc-issuer.

Left: item 3. At b1fb543640e7 ratchet baselines exist for 5 services (auth, api-gateway, m365-integration, security, vc-issuer). 20 other service tsconfig.json files still contain __tests__ (a grep, not a tsc run). The PR 874 link on this ticket is KS-926's docs PR and was never a fix for this.

## BLUF
**Items 1, 2 and 4 are merged for `services/auth`: #1480, squash `8cfab55b0e93`, on `develop`. It is NOT an automatic gate.** The ratchet runs when someone runs the services/auth vitest suite (the REAL cell) or `npm run check:test-types`; neither the pre-push hook, nor the 15 preflight legs, nor CI runs it. **The ticket stays open: item 3, the sibling-service sweep, is not done.**

## Recommendation
Keep open for item 3. Wire the check into the preflight (KS-1487) before relying on it at push time, and fix the five gaps the gate found (KS-1489).

## Detail
- **What landed:** `services/auth/tsconfig.test.json` (includes the tests), `scripts/typecheck-tests/check.cjs`, a baseline of the 42 errors that already exist (27 file+code entries, can only shrink), `npm run check:test-types`, and 7 cells. The checker fails on a new error, fails on a stale entry, says how many test files it examined (`tsc examined 139 files, 89 of them under __tests__` on the landed tree), and exits 2, not 0, when it examined none or tsc failed silently.
- **Wiring, as the gate measured it:** `check:test-types` is referenced only in `package.json`. The test header's claim that the author's pre-push gate runs the auth suite is false; it is corrected in KS-1489, and stated correctly in the PR and squash text.
- **Gate:** Sonnet-tier, GO WITH NOTE at head `a9b39631a740`, 0 Major; Wednesday's head-bound GO 2026-10-12T08:16:29Z. Its own mutants killed seven weaknesses and four survived: carded in KS-1489 with file-less diagnostics, the same-code swap, and tsconfig narrowing.
- **Re-proved on the landed tree:** `services/auth` on the predicted merge tree ran 89 files / 926 tests, 0 failed, twice; `check:test-types` rc 0 (42 in the baseline, 0 new, 0 stale); `tsc` source rc 0; the ks1000 file 7/7.
- **Verified at source:** one parent, tree equals the predicted tree, exactly the five files, per-file delta equal to the PR's own.
- **Consequence:** a test with a new type error now reds the auth suite for whoever runs it next.

- Seat V 3rd (Sonnet 5.5), 2026-10-12. Evidence: `5_Project_History/2026-10-12_seatV-3rd/` (`merge_1480.log`, `full_auth_1480_predicted.log`, `check_test_types_1480_predicted.log`, `ks1000_m*.log`).

## BLUF
**Unfixed and now re-measured; leaves my lot.** `services/auth/tsconfig.json` still excludes `src/__tests__`. On `develop` `a31b775`: `tsc -p . --listFilesOnly` lists 0 files under `src/__tests__` (50 source files), and a type error planted in a test file still passes `tsc --noEmit -p .` with rc 0. #874, the linked PR, is KS-926's docs PR and was never a fix for this.

## Recommendation
Item 1 of the ticket (decide the shape) is still the blocker. Measured for that decision: with `exclude: []` the service reports **about 41 type errors across its existing test tree**, so a second `tsconfig.test.json` plus a script needs either those fixed or baselined. One of them is mine (the ks1006 test, KS-1458 item 4). I have not built it: 41 mechanical test edits across other tickets' files is its own lot.

## Detail
- I wrote "includes `__tests__`" for `tsc` in three PR bodies today without checking; this ticket describes exactly that false green. Corrected on #1456, #1457 and #1458.
- Board state is Backlog at High; the allocation sheet had Low. The board wins. The linked #874 should not move it out of Backlog (see the 2026-09-14 comment).
- Seat V 3rd (Sonnet 5.5), 2026-10-12 (lot L06). Evidence: `5_Project_History/2026-10-12_seatV-3rd/` (`planted_red_L06.log`, `kintsugi_probe_L06_2026-10-12.out`).

**One line on the PR #874 link (s222, 2026-09-14 10:3x AEST — corrected 10:4x: the first version of this comment said the link had been archived, and it had not; Linear's API has no `attachmentArchive`, only `attachmentDelete`).** When KS-933 was marked Duplicate of this ticket, Linear's own mark-as-duplicate automation transferred KS-933's live relations (KS-926, KS-928, KS-930; KS-931's inverse) and its PR #874 attachment here. #874 is KS-926's docs PR ("state the family — ten checks that cannot fail"), one docs file — not a fix for this class — and a linked PR's merge can transition the linked ticket by itself (KS-933's comment 5d1ced9b records exactly that). **The #874 link is still on this ticket.** Whoever merges #874: this High, unworked class ticket must not leave Backlog on that merge — if it does, restore it. Whether the link is removed (`attachmentDelete` is the only verb Linear offers) is Wednesday's call. The three transferred `related` links (KS-926, KS-928, KS-930) stay — they are the family context KS-933 carried. Nothing else on this ticket changed.

**Carried here from KS-848, KS-933 and KS-1122 — each closed as Duplicate of this ticket and archived on 2026-09-14 (s222), under Kam's 2026-09-14 08:55 standing rule (true duplicates are closed and archived by us, no external review).** This is the class ticket for the `tsconfig.json` `exclude: ["src/__tests__"]` gap — item 3 above is the sibling sweep — so the per-service instances collapse here and the one fix shape is decided once and applied per service.

**Members of the class, one item per service:**
- `services/auth` — this ticket (develop at `133f525c8`: build 0 errors vs 25 errors across 14 test files with `src/__tests__` included; comment 20695981).
- `services/kyc` — from KS-848, measured 2026-09-06 at `8b91ab0ae`: `npx tsc --noEmit --listFiles | grep -c ks386-no-image-payload-written` → 0; a planted `const __tamper: number = "not a number";` reported TS2322 only under an explicit per-file invocation (reverted, md5 verified). The KS-386 guard, written under a tier-1 gate, is type-checked by nothing.
- `packages/shared` — from KS-933, measured 2026-09-06 on develop `ff5218867`: a plant in `ks914-shipped-path.test.ts` — `npm run build` exit 0, vitest 6 passed, `tsc` pointed at the file exit 2. Two things this ticket did not hold: (1) **`services/originate` uses ts-jest, which type-checks; `packages/shared` runs vitest, which does not** — the fix is per test runner as much as per tsconfig; (2) a second fix shape, `vitest --typecheck`. Instrument trap recorded there: grep the plant's type message (`not assignable`), not the variable name — TypeScript's message names the types. KS-933 was itself the survivor of KS-892 (Duplicate, archived 2026-09-08), whose `--listFiles` proof shows the compiler never opens a file under `src/__tests__`. KS-933's family context is the "checks that cannot fail" series — KS-926 (nothing runs it) · KS-927 (the positive half is dead) · KS-928 (the wiring is unasserted) · KS-930 (F-7) — and its other links are KS-914 (the two test files it measured), KS-873, KS-899, KS-931. PR #874, attached to KS-933, is KS-926's docs PR ("state the family"), not a fix for this class — its merge must not be read as closing anything here.
- `services/vc-issuer` — from KS-1122 (QA-966 F-4, PR #966): `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json --listFiles` rc 0 with 0 `__tests__` files (control: `routes/presentations.ts` present); a planted TS2322 ran 22/22 green under vitest and `eslint` rc 0 (`tseslint.configs.recommended`, not the type-checked set; no `parserOptions.project`). So eslint is not a layer either.
- `services/api-gateway` + `services/originate` — **KS-1090 stays open** (its R2-3 mint-scope item is a separate ask); its R2-2 half belongs to this class: both tsconfigs exclude `src/__tests__` (originate also `src/**/*.test.ts`); a plant in each of 3 test files rc 0, the same plant in `routes/proxy.ts` / `utils/gatewayProvenance.ts` rc 2; `--listFiles` 33 / 51 `src` files, 0 under `__tests__`. Both exclusions pre-date #951.

**Not measured by any member:** the other services (item 3). KS-993 is the `systemTest/fixtures` gap — a different directory, not this class.

**Priority:** High, this ticket's own (KS-848 and KS-933 were Medium, KS-1122 Low — nothing raised). Survivor by the rule: no member has a fixing PR; this ticket holds the most context (the class framing, the sweep item, the widest measurement); the older-id fallback was not reached.

## Measured evidence for this ticket, from the KS-732 / #872 work

`services/auth` **on develop** (at the KS-732 merge commit `133f525c8`):

| check | result |
|---|---|
| `npm run build` (`tsc`, the excluded config) | **0 errors** |
| `tsc` with `src/__tests__` **included** | **25 errors**, across **14 test files** |

Top offenders: `ks949-platform-admin-seed-identity` (7), `usersAdminStatus` (3),
`ks804-authorize-get-post-agree-per-rule` (2), `ks622-backup-code-at-login` (2),
`ks431-oauth-app-update` (2). Error classes include a top-level `await` that the
module target forbids (`TS1378`), an unsound `as` conversion (`TS2352`), and
unused declarations (`TS6133`).

**The count is identical before and after my change**, measured in a separate detached worktree at the
same commit — so all 25 are pre-existing and none came from #872. Stated because a bare "25 errors"
line invites the reader to assume the branch introduced them.

**What this ticket is really about, in one line:** `npm run build` returning 0 is not evidence that
the tests compile, and on this service it has not been for some time. It bit me directly on #872 — my
new test file failed to typecheck twice (an `AnchorSnapshot` union, then optional-vs-nullable) while
the build read green throughout.

Practical note for whoever takes this: a `tsconfig.tests.json` extending the base with
`include: ["src/**/*"]` and `exclude: ["node_modules","dist"]` reproduces it in one command, and the
control that proves it is really covering them is `--listFiles | grep -c 'src/__tests__'` — 12 in the
inclusive program versus 0 in the default one on `services/anchoring`, where I checked the same thing.
